proposed_comments.title: Normalize the name used to track connection success
proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize the name used to track connection success

**Severity:** `medium`

With a device name such as ` PC `, `SubmitConnectionRequestAsync` stores the spaces in `_pendingConnectMachineName`, but `ConnectToMachine` trims the name before adding it to the machine matrix. `CheckPendingConnectStatus` therefore cannot match the resulting `PC` socket state, even when it is `Connected`, and eventually reports a timeout and starts restoring the previous key. Trim the submitted name so the pending lookup and module use the same identifier; the existing case-insensitive lookup can remain unchanged.

```suggestion
            string pcName = ConnectPCNameTextBox.Text.Trim();
```

Verify that a name with surrounding spaces recognizes a successful connection instead of timing out.

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream production-method execution reproduces the failure under controlled inputs and the literal remedy removes it; source callers/guards traced. No physical-PC or live-network claim.

proposed_comments.title: Do not fail an active Name-to-IP attempt because DNS misses
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not fail an active Name-to-IP attempt because DNS misses

**Severity:** `medium`

A valid Name-to-IP mapping starts its connection thread before `Dns.GetHostEntry` runs, so a DNS miss does not mean that the mapped attempt failed. Setting the earlier dummy socket to `HostNotFound` makes `RequestMachineSocketStateAsync` keep that status instead of a later mapped socket's `Connecting` or `Connected` status; Settings then reports failure and starts restoring the previous key. Use `NA` for the DNS placeholder when mapped attempts were started, allowing their status to be observed, while retaining `HostNotFound` when no mapping is available.

```suggestion
                    UpdateTcpSockets(dummyTcp, useName2IP ? SocketStatus.NA : SocketStatus.HostNotFound);
```

Verify both a valid mapped address with an unresolvable name and an unmapped name that cannot resolve.
